pmc-13425631: A 2026 New Hampshire Colonoscopy Registry study on yield of synchronous adenomas and serrated polyps in patients with positive stool tests — mt-sDNA or FIT (the title is truncated). The stool tests' polyp yield was measured. The yield informs screening.
arxiv-2606-15931: Researchers built a multi-agent AI system that reasons about medical treatments by reading historical medical texts. The agents share knowledge through a "knowledge graph" — a web of linked facts drawn from old documents — so they can answer medical questions together. The paper describes the system's design and how it produces treatment reasoning from centuries-old material.
arxiv-2606-16431: A pure math paper about Novikov boards — odd number frames tied to flow math. It maps how these frames act on flat stages when they push from the right. The true details live in the paper; this take stays high.
arxiv-2606-16731: In group conversations, knowing who will speak next keeps talk flowing. MuVAP predicts turn-taking 'in the wild' using many signals at once — voices, faces, words — across several speakers. It is for speech researchers building natural conversational AI. Good guesses make bots less rude.
arxiv-2606-16831: A coding-theory paper on 'mixed block Markov superposition transmission codes': a new way to layer error-correcting codes so they protect data sent over noisy channels. The authors analyze the design. It is for communications engineers and coding theorists. Layered codes, tougher signals.
